reconnaissance_summary.censorship_and_self_censorship: HRW, Amnesty, OVD-Info, Golos, and the notebook document criminalized dissent, media closures, surveillance, intimidation, NGO exit, and self-censorship; domestic silence is therefore non-exculpatory.
chapter_specific_biases: Nuclear facility and conflict reporting may overrepresent visible external incidents; internal safeguards and command records are missing.
Conflict-access limits, proxy control, remedy implementation, and internal deliberations remain unclear.
Protest counts are visibility-biased; prison-wide conditions and national prevalence are incomplete.
Inherited OSCE and centralization material is not 2022 evidence; Golos report volume is not a misconduct denominator.
War and sanctions confound macroeconomic attribution; aggregate outcomes do not establish ruler competence.
Mortality quality, regional variation, affordability, and delivery gaps limit welfare interpretation.
Asset and sanctions evidence is allegation- or designation-heavy; opacity is not concealment proof.
Official instructions and institutional actions exceed independent audits; durable portfolio outcomes are unmeasured.
reconnaissance_summary.complaint_volume_interpretation: OVD-Info and Golos explicitly warn that counts reflect observer access or activity, not national prevalence; international scrutiny may overrepresent visible cases while repression suppresses domestic complaints.
reconnaissance_summary.criticism_possible: International organizations, external NGOs, OVD-Info, Golos, Amnesty, HRW, ICRC, UN mechanisms, and academic monitors provided criticism channels; domestic criticism was materially constrained.
reconnaissance_summary.duplicate_event_risk: High. Overlap includes E002/E003, E013/E017, E024/E025, E028/E029, E030/E031/E044, Treasury items, WHO items, macro items, and E056/E057/E063.
reconnaissance_summary.inherited_conditions_shocks_and_authorit: Local priors provide inherited nuclear, conflict, repression, political-freedom, economic, welfare, corruption, and governance context. The invasion, sanctions, mobilization, and facility exposure are shocks; E001 supplies formal authority. Local facts do not establish personal conduct.
languages_and_archives_searched: English-language Kremlin, UN, ICJ, ICC, OHCHR, IAEA, IMF, World Bank, SIPRI, ACA, CRS, DoD, DOJ, Treasury, WHO, UNICEF, ICRC, CSIS, OSW, Amnesty, HRW, AP, Axios, and academic sources.
Russian-language or domestic OVD-Info, Golos, Presidential Human Rights Council, Federal Tax Service, Rossiyskaya Gazeta, HSE, Rosstat, and OCCRP materials.
OSCE/ODIHR archives, WHO Europe materials, accountability records, sanctions and beneficial-ownership materials.
reconnaissance_summary.official_statistics_reliability: WHO warns about mortality-registration completeness and cause-of-death quality; UNICEF notes unavailable or earlier-year fields; Rosstat poverty material remains discovery-only; aggregate indicators are contextual.
reconnaissance_summary.relevant_denominators: Available denominators include population, observer coverage, prison population, political-prisoner estimates, regional and household health access, GDP, poverty, and asset-network totals, but complete national prevalence denominators are unavailable.
reconnaissance_summary.safe_reporting_channels: UN mechanisms, international courts, ICRC, international NGOs, OVD-Info, Golos, WHO, UNICEF, OSW, academic publications, and external investigative or sanctions records were safer channels than domestic official channels; no reliably safe domestic channel was documented.
reconnaissance_summary.source_concentration: Evidence is concentrated in international institutions, external NGOs, sanctions authorities, and a limited number of domestic monitors. Family overlap is retained as non-independent; 7B relies heavily on investigative and sanctions evidence and 6B on institutional country sources.
